thread:
alex.k: Getting AccessDenied on kms:Decrypt from our app when it assumes cross-account role to decrypt stored envelope keys. Started right after we rotated the CMK last night.

marta: Which CMK alias is this? data/master-envelope-prod or something else?

alex.k: alias/prod/envelope-main. Flow: service account in app-account assumes role arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/app-decryptor -> calls KMS in prod-account to Decrypt ciphertext generated by encryptor-lambda.

raj: Quick check: any CreateGrant/RevokeGrant events around rotation? Also look at whether rotation script called DisableKey or re-imported key material.

alex.k: CloudTrail shows a CreateGrant for arn:aws:iam::444455556666:role/rotation-bot immediately after rotation. No grant for app-decryptor. No RevokeGrant events logged.

marta: If the encryptor used a grant at encrypt time and the grant was never persisted as a GrantToken alongside the blob, decrypt will fail when the grant no longer exists or isn't presented by the decrypting principal.

sec-bot: Alert: kms:Decrypt denied for principal arn:aws:sts::111122223333:assumed-role/app-decryptor/session-9abc (API: Decrypt, Error: AccessDenied)

ops-sre: From prod-account, run:

aws kms list-grants --key-id alias/prod/envelope-main

and from the app pod:

aws sts get-caller-identity

alex.k: sts shows assumed-role arn:aws:sts::111122223333:assumed-role/app-decryptor/session-9abc. list-grants shows only rotation-bot grant.

raj: That matches. Two remediation options: 1) create a grant for app-decryptor in the CMK account that allows Decrypt/GenerateDataKey (fast), or 2) update key policy to give the app role kms:Decrypt (longer-term). Also confirm encryption-context exact match.

marta: Also check whether the encryptor passed a GrantToken back and whether code stored it with the ciphertext. If encryptor created an ephemeral grant and then deleted it, stored ciphertext that depended on the grant will break.

alex.k: Encryptor never persisted a GrantToken. It created an ephemeral grant for a streaming re-encrypt step and then deleted it. Rotation likely changed permissions and the ephemeral path is now failing.

ops-sre: Quick fix applied: created grant for arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/app-decryptor via:

aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/prod/envelope-main --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/app-decryptor --operations Decrypt GenerateDataKey

alex.k: After grant creation, decrypt calls from app succeeded. Confirmed in automated job.

marta: Follow-ups: remove ephemeral-grant pattern from encryptor, store encryption-context metadata with blobs, add integration test that rotates CMK and verifies decryption from all consumer roles.

raj: Add an alert on CloudWatch when KMS Decrypt AccessDenied spikes and add a runbook: list-grants, check CT for CreateGrant/RevokeGrant, verify GrantToken usage, validate encryption-context and session policies.

ops-sre: Also remember cross-account decrypt requires the grant/policy to reference the grantee principal in the CMK account; CreateGrant must be executed in the CMK account.

alex.k: Filing follow-up SEC ticket: SEC-4127. Tagging @sec-team. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
